description: Defines classes and interfaces for SPDY protocol framing, including SpdyFramer and related frame sequence classes, with methods for serializing various SPDY frames and managing HPACK header compression.

classes.name: SpdyFrameSequence
classes.description: Interface for a sequence of SPDY frames, with methods for serialization and iteration.

classes.name: SpdyFramer
classes.description: Main class for creating, serializing, and managing SPDY protocol frames, including support for HPACK compression.

classes.name: SpdyFrameIterator
classes.description: Base class for iterating over SPDY frames during serialization.

classes.name: SpdyHeaderFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterates over header frames, handling large header blocks.

classes.name: SpdyPushPromiseFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterates over push promise frames with large header blocks.

classes.name: SpdyControlFrameIterator
classes.description: Converts a single SPDY frame IR into a sequence for serialization.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates a frame sequence iterator for a given frame IR.
